method.decrypt: LIB_0203 PCGet selector 0 (tools/udc_db_decrypt.py). Ciphertext header 11 bytes stripped; period-256 BASE256 plus per-file even/odd mask. Not a new key search.
method.rot254_note: analyze_s03_udcgrid.py rot-254-of-header is a leftover false path; this pass uses .plain only.
method.endian: u16 big-endian (same as live KennPar ITN payloads)
method.axis_prefix: 2-byte BE length = byte count of the point list (maps.md rule)
method.plain_off_note: KennPar dat_off is into the decrypted cal image, not ciphertext+11.

summary.note: UDC db/*.dat files are stock year/transmission calibrations, not Smarty SW0–SW9. Filenames like 19980PUMan44J encode year + Aut/Man + a two-digit family code; there is no +30/+60/race file in the lab. SW0–9 live in handheld .Smt CaTCHER slots as F7 patch streams, not as KennPar tables.

sw_levels_published.title: Half power / no-smoke
sw_levels_published.qty: About half the power of a stock software

sw_levels_published.title: Fuel Saver
sw_levels_published.qty: +~2 MPG reported; timing rather aggressive; heavy towing not recommended

sw_levels_published.title: Fuel + boost fooling
sw_levels_published.qty: Increases fuel delivered by the ECM and does boost fooling; no added timing

sw_levels_published.title: SW2 + timing
sw_levels_published.qty: Same as SW2 with timing added. No HP number published.

sw_levels_published.title: CaTCHER
sw_levels_published.qty: Even = no extra timing (for timing boxes); odd = added timing. Top-RPM power almost identical across 4-9; higher # = more aggressive throttle from idle. SW8/9 can be hard to handle on slippery roads.
sw_levels_published.source: Tome Smarty03.html CaTCHER Four to Nine

summary.catcher_blocker: S03V126 decoded flash (FLASH_KEY) does not contain factory FLFL / 4DTA / 5DFL tables as big-endian KennPar grids (no axis/Z cribs). Five CaTCHER slots are fuel/boost-family F7 streams; L0 is SW0 half-power, not stock. Timing even/odd SW pairs are U2 knobs, not extra SMT copies. No cell-level IQ/timing/5DFL delta vs factory A/B can be produced from the .Smt.
